subject: Embed an R console into a Shiny webpage

messages.author: da6e94a792d44183
messages.subject: Embed an R console into a Shiny webpage
parts:
Is there a way to embed an R console into a Shiny webpage, where the user can type in the commands and get instant printed results from the dataset loaded into the server?

If so, that would be great! It could make debugging easier and allow my colleagues to explore the dataset in their own ways.
